consistency: Independent table reads; source row count and DDL checked before and after each export

tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE plexus_graph.nodes
(
    `node` Nullable(Int32),
    `osm_node` Nullable(Int64),
    `lat` Nullable(Float64),
    `lon` Nullable(Float64),
    `comp` Nullable(Int32)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY node
SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1, index_granularity = 8192

CREATE TABLE plexus_graph.edges
(
    `src` Nullable(Int32),
    `dst` Nullable(Int32),
    `h` Nullable(Float32),
    `km` Nullable(Float32),
    `way_idx` Nullable(Int32)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (way_idx, src, dst)
SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1, index_granularity = 8192

CREATE TABLE plexus_graph.ways
(
    `way_id` Nullable(Int64),
    `highway` Nullable(String),
    `ref` Nullable(String),
    `name` Nullable(String),
    `surface` Nullable(String),
    `tracktype` Nullable(String),
    `oneway` Nullable(String),
    `is_bridge` Nullable(Bool),
    `is_ferry` Nullable(Bool),
    `is_seasonal` Nullable(Bool),
    `way_idx` Nullable(Int32),
    `speed_kmh` Nullable(Float64),
    `km` Nullable(Float64),
    PROJECTION by_osm_id
    (
        SELECT
            way_id,
            way_idx
        ORDER BY way_id
    ),
    PROJECTION by_reference
    (
        SELECT
            way_idx,
            way_id,
            name,
            ref,
            km
        ORDER BY ref
    )
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY way_idx
SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1, index_granularity = 8192

CREATE TABLE plexus_graph.locations
(
    `point_id` Nullable(String),
    `settlement` Nullable(String),
    `region` Nullable(String),
    `node` Nullable(Int64),
    `lon` Nullable(Float64),
    `lat` Nullable(Float64),
    `snap_km` Nullable(Float64),
    `population` Nullable(Int32),
    INDEX place_name lowerUTF8(ifNull(settlement, '')) TYPE ngrambf_v1(3, 8192, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (region, point_id)
SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1, index_granularity = 1024

CREATE TABLE plexus_graph.road_costs
(
    `way_idx` Int32,
    `way_id` Int64,
    `highway` String,
    `surface` Nullable(String),
    `lanes_total` Nullable(UInt16),
    `lanes_forward` Nullable(UInt16),
    `lanes_backward` Nullable(UInt16),
    `oneway` Nullable(String),
    `posted_speed_kmh` Nullable(Float64),
    `hourly_flow_pcu` Nullable(Float64),
    `flow_verified` Bool,
    `lane_data_usable` Bool,
    `flow_source` String,
    `flow_period` String,
    `hourly_flow_scope` String,
    `is_ferry` Bool,
    `source_speed_kmh` Nullable(Float64),
    `effective_speed_kmh` Float64,
    `freeflow_speed_kmh` Float64,
    `capacity_pcu_h` Nullable(Float64),
    `lane_basis` String,
    `capacity_basis` String,
    `flow_basis` String,
    `method_version` String
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY way_idx
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

CREATE TABLE plexus_atlas.atlas_metadata
(
    `key` String,
    `value` String,
    `ordinal` UInt32
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY key
SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1, index_granularity = 1024
